capabilities: Copy a link or embed link to the current line or block
Copy selected text with each line or the first line linked to its source
Set the copied link's text from the selection or clipboard
Configure link placement in copied text with a regular expression
disambiguation: Not a task-rollover plugin; it copies selected text with source links, which can be used to carry tasks forward between daily notes.
extras: The README notes that the repository has no automated tests and requests help adding them.
problem: Obsidian makes it hard to copy text into another note while automatically preserving a link to the exact line it came from, which methods like Bullet Journaling need when moving tasks between daily notes.
summary: Copy selected text with links back to its source note, or copy links and embed links to individual lines and blocks.
